prompt: Desktop application UI design mockup ABI Billing, extremely minimal and spacious like reference go.o11.ai: white background, light gray rounded rows, black text and restrained blue primary actions, no dark sidebar. Landscape 3:2. Header ABI; Overview, Catalog, Connect, Billing selected, Settings. Main title Billing. Simple Overview / Spending limits segmented tabs. A quiet top row: 'Card-funded credits' '$0.00' and 'Settlement funds' '0.00 USDC', primary blue 'Add credits'. Explicit small note 'Design preview · payment provider not connected'. Below 'Auto top-up' as a single light-gray settings row with disabled switch and helper 'Add a payment method before enabling'. Below three compact fields in same row labeled 'When credits fall below' '$5.00', 'Add' '$20.00', 'Monthly auto top-up cap' '$100.00', disabled save settings button. Main lower section 'Payment methods' with Add card outlined button and plain 'No saved payment methods'. Lower section 'Funding activity' simple table Status, Description, Amount, Date, empty state 'Verified payments and refunds will appear here'. Right slim contextual panel 'Connect / API keys' with a mock labeled key row 'Shopping agent', 'Scoped to General allowance', 'Secret shown once', 'View permissions', 'Replace', 'Revoke' controls; do NOT display any fake secret or API token. Visible permissions badges 'Run approved tools', 'No key management', and text 'Replacing a key keeps its allowance and history'. Quiet footnote 'Adding credits does not raise agent spending limits.' No card-number entry fields, no payment logos, no claimed live provider, no promotional free credit. Coherent ABI proposal, not o11 branding; legible aligned fields, soft gray surfaces, only real control semantics.
scope: ABI redesign studies inspired by public o11 design; not live functionality
notes: Generated text and capabilities are proposals. Keep key administration in Connect; do not literalize sidebar from billing study as permanently exposing secrets. No free-credit promise or existing card processor is implied.
